notes: Created from the 2026-10-19 HuggingFace discovery crawl. Benchmarks are the card's own published rows (vendor claims). architecture and task are inferred from the slug and param ratio; KV geometry, context length and quant sizes are not yet filled, hence status draft. KV basis: KV is carried by the thinker's MoE text decoder: thinker_config.text_config, hidden_size 2048, num_hidden_layers 48, num_attention_heads 32, num_key_value_heads 4 (gqa_ratio 8), head_dim 128 explicit, num_experts 128 with num_experts_per_tok 8, max_position_embeddings 65,536, mrope rope_scaling [24,20,20], rope_theta 1e6, use_sliding_window false, use_cache true. 2 (K+V) x 48 layers x 4 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 bytes (bf16) = 98,304 B/token. The talker is a second, smaller decoder (20 layers, 16 heads / 2 KV heads, hidden 1024) that only allocates KV when the model is asked to emit speech, adding 2 x 20 x 2 x 128 x 2 = 20,480 B/token on the audio-output path; the audio and vision encoders are prefilled once. Expert count does not affect per-token KV -- only the 4 KV heads and 48 layers do. REVIEWED 2026-10-21: card confirms every claimed row. Card publishes all six rows (MMAU, VoiceBench Overall, MMSU, Seed-TTS en/zh, WorldSense) with matching values.
